package main

import "fmt"

var trace []string

func f() {
	trace = append(trace, "package f")
	f := func() {
		trace = append(trace, "local f")
	}
	f()
}

func g(n int) int {
	if n == 0 {
		return 0
	}
	g := func(k int) int { return k * 10 }
	return g(n) + 1
}

func h(z int) {
	h := func(z int) {
		trace = append(trace, fmt.Sprint("local h ", z))
	}
	h(z + 1)
}

func main() {
	f()
	trace = append(trace, fmt.Sprint("g(3)=", g(3)))
	h(500)
	// Outside the shadowing scope the package function is the callee again.
	f()
	fmt.Println(trace)
}
